effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC from their wallet to the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
The vault mints vault shares (MC-USDC) to `onBehalf`. The amount is previewDeposit(assets), set by the share price in storage after fee accrual. The contract enforces no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit 1678.470684 USDC for the shown address, with the share ticker MC-USDC and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares arrive; the share price comes from storage and has no minimum
findings.evidence: VaultV2.deposit: `accrueInterest(); uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The descriptor shows only 'Share ticker' = MC-USDC. Case 0: the signer received 1656.177437935390510941 MC-USDC, and no amount was on screen.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The contract takes no minShares parameter that could be shown.

cases.notes: The USDC out (1678.470684) is shown right. The MC-USDC in shows the asset and the recipient, but no amount: the amount comes from the share price in storage.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns previewWithdraw(assets) vault shares from `onBehalf`. The share price in storage sets the amount, and the contract enforces no maximum.
When the signer is not `onBehalf`, the call spends that number of shares from the share allowance that `onBehalf` gave the signer.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 1500 USDC to the receiver, with the owner whose shares pay for it.

findings.title: withdraw never says that MC-USDC vault shares are burned from the owner to pay for the USDC
findings.evidence: VaultV2.exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares);`. The descriptor fields are 'Withdraw exactly', 'To' and 'Owner'. No field or intent names MC-USDC. Case 2: the signer lost 1482.774223891873209831 MC-USDC, and the screen did not name that asset.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Shares burned","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}. Rename 'Owner' to 'Burn shares from'. Do not add the field to interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: withdraw cannot show how many shares are burned; the amount comes from storage and has no cap
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);`. The ABI has no maxShares argument.

cases.notes: The USDC in (1500 to the signer) is shown right. The MC-USDC burn is not named, and its amount comes from storage. The reader guessed 'vault shares' without an amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `onBehalf`. When the signer is not `onBehalf`, the call spends the share allowance of the signer.
The vault sends previewRedeem(shares) USDC to `receiver`. The share price in storage sets the amount, and the contract enforces no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 5764.96 MC-USDC to the receiver, with the owner. The asset received is never named.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets
findings.evidence: VaultV2.exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. The redeem fields are 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. None names USDC, but the mint format uses the constant underlyingTicker. Case 3: the signer received 5842.044577 USDC, and the reader wrote 'presumably USDC'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}. Change interpolatedIntent to "Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}".

findings.title: redeem cannot show how much USDC arrives; the amount comes from storage and has no minimum
findings.evidence: VaultV2.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. There is no minAssets parameter.

cases.notes: The MC-USDC out is shown right. The USDC in (5842.044577) is not named and has no amount. The reader guessed the asset.

effects: The signer sends previewMint(shares) USDC to the vault. The share price in storage sets the amount, and no maximum exists beyond the signer's allowance.
The vault mints exactly `shares` vault shares (MC-USDC) to `onBehalf`.
formats.shown: Mint 1 MC-USDC for 0x…dEaD, with 'Deposit asset: USDC' and no USDC amount.

findings.title: mint intent and sentence do not say that the signer pays USDC for the minted shares
findings.evidence: The descriptor has intent "Mint" and interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". VaultV2.enter: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets);`. In case 1 the signer paid 1 USDC, and only the field 'Deposit asset: USDC' hints at it.
findings.fix: Change intent to "Deposit USDC to mint shares" and interpolatedIntent to "Pay USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}".

findings.title: mint cannot show how much USDC leaves the signer; the cost comes from storage and has no cap
findings.evidence: VaultV2.mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. There is no maxAssets parameter. Case 1: 1 USDC left the signer, and no amount was on screen.

cases.notes: The USDC out (1 USDC) shows the asset only, without an amount. The shares went to 0xdead (signer null), which the screen shows right.
